name: slopwatch
description: SlopWatch — AI slop gate for PR diffs. (1) Hallucination Registry: extracts every import and verifies it against PyPI/npm + installed APIs, BLOCKS on hallucinated packages. (2) Blueprint Asserter: greps for architecture violations (raw SQL, reinvented formatters, raw HTTP, print logging). (3) Ghost Path Hunter: flags swallowed exceptions (except: pass), empty catch blocks, silent fallbacks and TODO placeholders. (4) watsonx.ai remediation: Granite generates a fix suggestion per top finding (rule templates when offline).

target.description: Local path OR GitHub URL (https://github.com/owner/repo) to scan. GitHub URLs are shallow-cloned automatically.

branch.description: Branch to checkout when target is a GitHub URL.

explain.description: Attach watsonx.ai (Granite) remediation suggestions to top findings. Falls back to rule templates offline.

diff.description: Path to a unified diff file — restricts the scan to touched files.

blueprint.description: Path to custom blueprint rules JSON (added to the defaults).

demo.description: Run with pre-recorded demo data instead of a live scan.

findings.description: Each finding: id, scanner, file, line, message, fix.

examples.title: Demo gate run
examples.description: 6 pre-recorded findings (1 BLOCK, 5 WARN) in ~1 second, no network needed.

examples.title: Live gate on a PR workspace
examples.description: Scans every .py/.ts/.js file; exit code 1 when hallucinations block the merge.
